name: MP-20
description: About 45,000 Materials Project structures with at most 20 atoms per cell (CDVAE split). In the MEIDNet paper it tests how the crystal encoder and decoder generalise beyond perovskites; no property modality was aligned on it and no MP-20 checkpoint is shipped in this repository.
citation: Jain et al., APL Mater. 1, 011002 (2013); Xie et al., ICLR 2022 (CDVAE)
role: published: structure-representation generalization (not a multimodal benchmark)
